Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.deathmatch

Record Class DeathmatchSettingsSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.deathmatch.DeathmatchSettingsSnapshot
Record Components:
configured - whether a template world is set, which a deathmatch needs
templateWorld - the world copied for each deathmatch
spawnType - RANDOM or CUSTOM
freezeSeconds - how long players are frozen after arriving
blockDecayEnabled - whether blocks players place decay
blockDecayStartDelaySeconds - the delay before a placed block starts decaying
blockDecayDurationSeconds - how long a placed block takes to decay
protectOriginalBlocks - whether blocks of the arena itself cannot be broken
customSpawns - the configured spawns, used with CUSTOM
borderPos1 - one corner of the configured bounds, or null
borderPos2 - the other corner of the configured bounds, or null
public record DeathmatchSettingsSnapshot(boolean configured, @NotNull String templateWorld, @NotNull String spawnType, int freezeSeconds, boolean blockDecayEnabled, double blockDecayStartDelaySeconds, double blockDecayDurationSeconds, boolean protectOriginalBlocks, @NotNull List<org.bukkit.Location> customSpawns, @Nullable org.bukkit.Location borderPos1, @Nullable org.bukkit.Location borderPos2) extends Record
The deathmatch configuration of settings.yml, read at one moment. A snapshot whose locations are copies.

This is the default deathmatch. A scenario or addon answering GameplayHooks#DEATHMATCH_DESTINATION - through a scenario or GameplayHookService - can send a match elsewhere.

Since:
1.8.0
